3277-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

176-4875-7272.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
176-4875-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2390-3966-7862.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-7862.description:
Gain life.
Citizen V triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-4247-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-4247-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-2350-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-2350-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5070-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5070-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1809-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4268-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4268-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2035-6462-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gollum.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2713-6441-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Zirda, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2713-6441-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

1550-4251-7296.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-7296.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2099-7219.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability
Repeat.

1661-2921-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-2921-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

527-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding {G} plus an amount of colored mana equal to the greatest power among creatures you control minus 1.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
527-4038-5963.notes: The mana cost can be reduced to {G} if you control a creature with power 3 or greater as you start the combo.

2894-3885-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2894-3885-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Stinkweed Imp. Then, the draw will be replaced by Stinkweed Imp's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

57-955-4235-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-955-4235-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3933-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {7}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3933-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1170-1251-1329-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

570-625-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
570-625-1978.description:
Cause Faeburrow Elder to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
1251-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4659-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
3755-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-4657-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
539-4657-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

751-1636-6406.notablePrerequisites:
You control enough creatures such that you can cast Shrieking Drake between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}.
751-1636-6406.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
751-1636-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-2079-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4002-4452.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
3767-3918-4002-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1315-2173-4423-4426-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-4423-4426-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-4423-4426-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-4423-4426-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1339-5719-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5719-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Molten Gatekeeper triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
The Locust God triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve a trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat from step 3.

813-1987-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3327-4549-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-4549-5256.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Repeat.

1558-1770-2963-4231-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1494-2646-3557.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
 Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1494-2646-3557.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1283-2803-3750.notablePrerequisites: Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1283-2803-3750.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {5}.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power six or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

643-2415-4508.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
643-2415-4508.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2034-2698-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2698-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from any creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Vogar's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Vogar.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

937-2935-4551.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
